intro: Timbermaw Post is a small furbolg camp situated in the snowy expanse of Winterspring, nestled between Frostfire Hot Springs and Lake Kel'Theril. Despite bearing the name of the uncorrupted Timbermaw tribe, the encampment has fallen under the aggressive grip of the corrupted Winterfall furbolgs.

p: Positioned just southeast across the road from Frostfire Hot Springs and west of the frozen Lake Kel'Theril, Timbermaw Post stands as a bitter reminder of the furbolgs' internal strife in Winterspring. Despite its Timbermaw name, travelers approaching the camp will find no friendly welcomes. The outpost is controlled by the hostile Winterfall tribe, driven mad and violent by demonic corruption. Now crowded with savage Winterfall furbolgs, the camp serves as an aggressive staging ground encroaching upon the central road.
